text: She was there, by the low lamp, hand on the shutter, watching the ship come on through the crack.
Gus did not shout. He set his lantern down on the sand.
You kept it lit, little one. Sixty years. I watched you every night.
The sea has my debt. A ship for every year it gave me. Four ships. Then I am free.
Gus put his hand on the hot shutter, next to hers.
Then the man who has never let a light go out, closed one.
